_comment: SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later — Hand-curated inventory for the abstractions catalog: the web UI (Vue) and the native audio code (C), which TSDoc/typedoc cannot read. Committed as source; merged with the generated core and server listing at build time by scripts/gen-abstractions.mjs. Each entry is a name and one plain-prose line; it names no source path.

items.name: useResource
items.summary: The one write/read client for a REST row: optimistic hold, refusal surfacing, supersede-by-later-write.

items.name: useContract
items.summary: Reads a row's declared OPTIONS contract — the writable fields, ranges and enumerated options.

items.name: useStripRow
items.summary: Write-backed binding to one channel strip's row.

items.name: strip-view-store
items.summary: Read-only per-channel row binding, split out to break an import cycle with useStripRow.

items.name: row-store-registry
items.summary: The central registry every declared row store joins, so a test can reset every store and stream in one call.

items.name: useVisibleDemand
items.summary: Turns a widget's on-screen visibility into the demand signal that lets nothing compute unwatched.

items.name: useConsoleStream
items.summary: The one EventSource connection to the console — every SSE stream in the surface goes through it.

items.name: useNumberFormat
items.summary: Locale-aware numeric display formatting.

items.name: useDeclaration
items.summary: Reads a resource's declared schema and limits.

items.name: useTraceDemand
items.summary: Demand-gates a trace-buffer subscription.

items.name: useScreenClass
items.summary: Responsive breakpoint classification.

items.name: useTheme
items.summary: Reads the active theme's tokens.

items.name: useControlDescriptor
items.summary: Generic control metadata — label, unit and range — for a declared field.

items.name: ConfirmButton
items.summary: Arm-then-fire two-tap confirmation for an unrecoverable action, including the global no-confirmation escape hatch.

items.name: db, FADER_TAPER
items.summary: The one canonical fader position↔dB taper, shared by the fader widget, the channel tile and the model.

items.name: Fader
items.summary: The base fader widget — taper, drag and keyboard nudge — wrapped by the gain fader and the fader bank.

items.name: Encoder, EncoderRow
items.summary: A rotary parameter control, alone or as a labelled row.

items.name: Meter
items.summary: The per-strip level meter.

items.name: ConsoleSelect
items.summary: A styled select control with contrast handling built in.

items.name: Stepper
items.summary: A stepped +/- numeric control.

items.name: NudgeField
items.summary: A numeric field with nudge buttons.

items.name: SchemaForm, SchemaField
items.summary: Generic form rendering from a declared schema.

items.name: mix_dsp
items.summary: The shared DSP kernel library: click-free gain ramps, gate/EQ/compressor primitives, bus summing, output delay and the real-FFT analyser.

items.name: mixer_state
items.summary: The node's state layout and its concurrency contract — which fields are word-atomic, real-time-owned, or release/acquire.

items.name: omx_napi
items.summary: The one JS-boundary argument-fetch-and-validate shape every native binding declares its signature through.

items.name: mix_bus
items.summary: The summing bus: width folding, sparsity skipping, one send struct for every bus in the desk.

items.name: mix_lane
items.summary: The one processing-lane stage walk shared verbatim by every channel strip and the master lane.

items.name: mix_order
items.summary: The data-driven, allocation-free per-strip stage order — a reorderable chain of gate, EQ, compressor, delay, reverb and insert steps.

items.name: mix_host
items.summary: The addon's one shared, refcounted PipeWire client and thread loop.

items.name: mix_delay
items.summary: The real-time-safe stereo delay-line kernel, used as a send/return or an insert.

items.name: mix_reverb
items.summary: One Schroeder-Moorer comb-and-allpass kernel serving both room and hall reverbs, plus a Dattorro plate kernel.

items.name: mix_tap
items.summary: The named tap-point bank: post-trim, pre-EQ, post-EQ, pre-fader, post-fader.

items.name: mix_insert
items.summary: The in-lane hosted-plugin send/return detour.

items.name: mix_rec
items.summary: The real-time-safe capture ring: monotonic cursors, a counted gap standing in for silence.

items.name: mix_pb
items.summary: The playback ring counterpart to mix_rec.h — lockstep multitrack reads, silence on a stall.

items.name: mix_loop
items.summary: Routing-loop (howl-round) graph detection, kept as the one topology mirror in the codebase.

items.name: mix_rf64
items.summary: The WAV/RF64 grammar — the single writer and reader for every take file.

items.name: hrp_baseline, hrp_attribute, hrp_pitch, hrp_track, hrp_analyze
items.summary: The composed HRP (harmonic reference pitch) pipeline: pitch, then attribution, then baseline, then tracking, one contract per stage.

items.name: generator
items.summary: Talkback and test-signal source nodes, sharing mix_host.h's client.

items.name: DerivedResource
items.summary: A read-only row recomputed on every read.

items.name: ScalarRecordResource
items.summary: One writable scalar or record per address.

items.name: CollectionResource
items.summary: An addressable multi-item collection, such as a set of EQ bands.

items.name: LatchResource
items.summary: Momentary or latched state, extending ScalarRecordResource.

items.name: OperationResource
items.summary: An action-style, POST-shaped resource.

items.name: ConsoleResource<S>
items.summary: The umbrella interface every row satisfies, for the rare row that needs more than a mold provides.

items.name: stripFieldRow()
items.summary: A generic builder that turns a strip field, its wire codec and its engine door into a full row.

items.name: StripStateController<...>
items.summary: The shared base behind the compressor, delay, reverb and gate controllers.

groups.label: Controllers
groups.summary: State plus a broadcastable frame, with no I/O of their own.

groups.label: Stores
groups.summary: Persisted state, one module per concern.

items.name: protocol
items.summary: Every outbound wire frame shape, each with its own builder function — the one declared home for what goes out on the wire.

items.name: rest-router
items.summary: The single REST door. It names no entity itself, which is what lets every row be plain configuration instead of wiring its own HTTP verbs.
